messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@brightbridge.io>

Date: 2027-04-11 09:12 -0700
Subject: Renewal health review & capacity ask

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you9re well. We9re coming up on our annual renewal and I wanted to share BrightBridge9s March usage snapshot and a couple of asks up front: we9re planning a new user-facing summarization feature that will increase generation volume (higher avg tokens per request) and we9d like to explore options for smoothing costs while keeping latency under 300ms P95.

Attached is the raw usage export for March (BB_usage_Mar2027.csv). High-level: 30% MoM spike in generated tokens, 18% increase in embedding lookups. We9re evaluating either adding a dedicated capacity commit or keeping hosted but moving to a mixed-model routing strategy.

Would you and your team be available next week for a 30-minute renewal health review and to talk about a proposal? Our procurement lead (contracts@brightbridge.io) and legal (legal@brightbridge.io) should be on the call if we discuss terms.

Thanks,
Alex Reed
Head of Platform
BrightBridge Labs

Alex,

Thanks for the export and the heads up. I9ve looped in Marissa (renewals analytics) and Rishi (solutions) to pull a short ROI + performance summary and a recommendation for a mixed-model routing approach that keeps perceived latency low while reducing unit cost per token.

Quick plan:
- Marissa will run a token-mix and prefix cache analysis (token_breakdown_Mar.pdf).
- Rishi will validate latency projections for a two-model strategy (smaller distil model for conversational turns + large model for final generation).
- I9ll draft a renewal proposal with a 3-tier commit option, burst credits, and a 30-day proof-of-concept window for the mixed-model route.

Proposed times for a 30-min sync: Tue 4/13 10:00 or Wed 4/14 09:00 PT. Which works for you and your contracts/legal folks?

I9ll attach the ROI recap and a short dashboard snapshot ahead of the call.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12 16:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal - token mix analysis (internal)

Vanessa / Rishi,

I pulled the March export. Highlights:
- Total generated tokens: 42.1M (30% MoM).
- 62% of tokens come from two high-volume flows (search-assisted summarization + transcript cleanup).
- 18% embedding volume (mostly cold lookups).
- Current P95 latency for the long-form path: ~380ms on hosted endpoint (peaks at 520ms during bursts).

Recommendations:
1) Mixed-model routing: route short-turn interactive requests to a 7B fast model (quantized), final generation to the 34B family for quality. Estimated cost reduction: ~28% on unit token cost with similar end-user quality when paired with prefix caching.
2) Commit tier: a 20% uplift in committed tokens with a Dedicated burst pool for high concurrency windows reduces peak latency to sub-300ms P95 and provides predictability.
3) 30-day PoC: we provision a small Dedicated pool and instrument quality monitoring + rollback to hosted if regressions appear.

I9ve attached a token breakdown and a quick cost model (token_breakdown_Mar.pdf). I can join the call and walk through per-flow economics.

-Marissa
Senior Renewals Analyst, Redwood Inference
Attachment: token_breakdown_Mar.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@brightbridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Contracts <contracts@brightbridge.io>
Date: 2027-04-14 09:01 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal health review: proposed commit & mixed-model plan

Alex — thanks for making time earlier. Per our call and follow-up analysis, attached is a concise renewal proposal and the estimated ROI for the mixed-model routing approach. Summary (high level):

- Proposed commit: +20% annual committed token pool (adds predictable capacity for your new feature).
- Mixed-model routing: 7B quantized for interactive/short turns + 34B for final synthesis. Expected net unit-cost delta: -26%
- Dedicated burst pool: 4x smaller GPUs reserved for peak windows to keep P95 < 300ms during surge periods.
- 30-day PoC: full instrumentation + quality guardrails; we9ll enable automatic fallback to hosted if quality delta exceeds configurable thresholds.
- Pricing: incremental pricing model attached in BB_renewal_proposal_v1.pdf; includes a one-time onboarding credit and a reduced rate for embeddings for the committed tier.

Next steps I propose:
1) Contracts team to confirm amendment path (simple addendum vs. new SOW).
2) Legal to confirm standard DPA/SLAs (I9ve copied Contracts on this thread).
3) If greenlit, we provision PoC within 5 business days and run the 30-day evaluation with weekly checkpoints.

If this looks reasonable, can we lock in a sign-off meeting for Tue 4/19?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachment: BB_renewal_proposal_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.1 MB)
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@brightbridge.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@brightbridge.io>, legal@brightbridge.io, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-15 11:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal health review: proposed commit & mixed-model plan

Vanessa,

Appreciate the thorough proposal and the quick turnaround. The economics look compelling and the idea of a 30-day PoC with a rollback trigger is the right risk profile for us. Two quick asks before we proceed:

1) Can we get the PoC configured to mirror production traffic (we9ll share a sampling rule) so the telemetry is representative?
2) Contracts: prefer an addendum to the current agreement with the commit uplift and the PoC clause. Legal on our side will validate but wanted to flag that preference.

If those two items are doable we9re happy to move forward. Can we do a 30-min signature/ops sync on Tue 4/19 11:00 PT?

Also please include a short list of the rollback triggers for quality/regression monitoring in the addendum (Rishi, can you draft 3-4 triggers we can bake into the SLOs?).

Thanks,
Alex Reed
Head of Platform
BrightBridge Labs
